jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading, white lines only, no colour at all. People, animals and objects are drawn WHITE: white bodies, white clothes, white fills, never black-filled shapes or dark silhouettes. No text, letters or captions in the image. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: a forest clearing at night in thin white line art, tall pine trees, stars, a small campfire with warm orange flames. Scene: close-up of a small boy about eight years old drawn all in WHITE with white clothes, a child, much smaller than the man sitting on a log by the campfire, looking up worried, both arms wrapped around his knees, both hands clasped together. Only the boy. Normal human anatomy: each person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Each leg runs from the hip to ONE foot, the feet point the same way as the knees, no third foot or extra leg, and the legs of different people never merge or overlap; people in the background stand clearly apart from each other.
